Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns were recorded and analyzed using the Levenberg-Marquardt method and deconvoluted using a pseudo-Voigt fitting. All materials exhibit diffraction peaks of the different crystallographic planes located at the characteristic positions for a face centered cubic (fcc) structure, typical of metallic Pd and Au (Fig. 2a). The apparent mean crystallite sizes (Lv) have been calculated from the diffraction peak located close to 2θ = 40°, which corresponds to the (111) crystallographic plane of metallic palladium and gold (Eq. (4)).
